message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a metal chainmail costume. Costumes are classified in 9505 (festive articles) or in Chapter 61/62 as wearing apparel. Carnival or festive costumes of textile go in 6307.90 or Chapter 61/62. Costumes made of metal are not textile, so the question is whether Chapter 95 applies. Heading 9505 covers festive, carnival or other entertainment articles. Costumes of non-textile material, such as metal armor, would fall under 9505.90.

Alternative: heading 7616 (other articles of aluminum). Note 1(e) to Chapter 95 excludes certain items, but metal costumes are not excluded. Chapter 95 is likely, since the item is a renaissance fair costume, which is a festive or entertainment article. The code is 9505.90.6000 (Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles, other: other).

HTS 9505.90.60 is "Other" under 9505.90, and the 10-digit code is 9505.90.6000.
